# Awesome Agent Trading

> AI trading agents, MCP servers, OpenClaw skills, crypto bots, prediction market tools, data APIs, and risk-management resources.

Canonical site: http://laplaceagent.com/awesome-agent-trading/
GitHub repository: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading
Machine-readable data: https://github.com/laplace0x/awesome-agent-trading/blob/main/data/projects.json

## Summary

Awesome Agent Trading is a curated directory for building autonomous and semi-autonomous trading agents across crypto, DeFi, CEXs, TradFi, Hyperliquid, Polymarket, Kalshi, and other markets.

## Key topics

- AI trading agents
- Autonomous trading agents
- Agentic trading
- MCP servers for trading
- Model Context Protocol
- OpenClaw trading skills
- Crypto trading bots
- Prediction market agents
- Polymarket tools
- Kalshi tools
- Hyperliquid trading agents
- Risk management for autonomous trading systems
